---
format:
  typst:
    citeproc: true
    papersize: a4
    page-numbering: false
    margin:
      x: 1.2cm
      y: 1.2cm
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{=typst}
#set page(flipped: true)
#set text(size: 13pt)

// Bootstrap samples have to be the same size as the original sample, so change
// this if the sample isn't 21
#let n = 21
#let cols = 7

#let sheet-heading(body) = text(size: 17pt, weight: "bold", body)

#let boxes() = table(
  columns: (1fr,) * cols,
  rows: 50mm / calc.ceil(n / cols),
  stroke: 1pt,
  align: top + left,
  ..range(1, n + 1).map(i => text(weight: "light", str(i)))
)

#sheet-heading[Your bootstrap sample]
#v(-0.3em)
#boxes()

#v(1fr)

#sheet-heading[Your bootstrap sample, arranged in order]
#v(-0.3em)
#boxes()

#v(1fr)

#sheet-heading[Bootstrap median]
#v(-0.5em)
#text(weight: "light")[
  #if calc.even(n) [
    The number in between boxes #(calc.quo(n, 2)) and #(calc.quo(n, 2) + 1) in the ordered section above
  ] else [
    The number in box #(calc.quo(n, 2) + 1) in the ordered section above
  ]
]
#v(-0.3em)
#rect(width: 20%, height: 25mm, stroke: 1pt)
```
